---
title: "James Bond Films Analysis"
---

```{python}
#| include: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]

```

This page analyzes only James Bond films. The first Bond films in this dataset aired in `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` and the last Bond film aired in `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

```{python}
#| echo: true

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))
ax.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (millions of U.S. dollars)")
plt.show()

```
